summary: Iteration 107 — production stock deduction cycle. Created 13 new pytest cases for /api/sauna-production/cost/production-stock/{preview,deduct,revert}/{lead_id} and /api/sauna-crm/leads/{lead_id}/to-production auto-deduct path. All 13/13 pass. Regression: previous procurement delivery suite (iter 106) re-run = 16/16 pass. No backend bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: sauna_crm.py grows past 1791 lines — consider splitting (leads CRUD vs production/amocrm push helpers vs settings).
sauna_tech_cards.py 1156 lines — also nearing the 700-line guideline; the new production-stock block (~250 lines) is a good candidate to extract into routes/sauna_production_stock.py for isolation.

deduct_production_stock claims idempotency via `productionStockDeducted` flag but there is a non-atomic window between the flag set and stock updates (no transaction). Under heavy concurrency two simultaneous to-production calls could both pass the flag check before either commits. Acceptable for single-admin-user workflow, but document the limitation.

to-production sets productionStockDeducted=True even when no BOM was matched (applied=0). Behaviour is documented (no-op claim to prevent retry storms) — confirmed by test test_to_production_without_bom_returns_applied_zero. Good.
All endpoints correctly exclude Mongo `_id` (verified) and use Pydantic / dict input validation.
seed_data_creation: Per-test TEST_PSD_* components, TEST_M_/TEST_V_/TEST_O_ synthetic model/variant/option ids, TEST_LEAD_* CRM leads, TEST_AMO_* amocrm_ids (to dodge unique index on null amocrm_id). All cleaned up in module-scoped autouse fixture (DELETE via API for leads & tech-cards, direct Mongo purge for sauna_components + sauna_stock_movements).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two non-bug test-script gotchas worth knowing for this codebase: (1) GET /api/sauna-production/cost/components returns {items: [...], count: n}, not a bare list. (2) sauna_crm_leads has a UNIQUE index on amocrm_id — second test lead with null amocrm_id triggers 500 E11000. Always set a unique TEST_AMO_* string when creating multiple test leads. The test file test_production_stock_deduction.py uses both workarounds and is reusable as regression for iter 107+.
rca of the issue: No production bugs found. All assertions on stock deltas, audit movements (type=out/in, before/after, qty, componentId, leadId, actorUsername='admin', note='Списание производство...' / 'Возврат списания производства...'), 409 Conflict idempotency, 400 race-protection on to-production, no-op claim for leads without BOM, and multi-card BOM aggregation (variant + option scope) all behave as specified.
